svg.text: Week 9 · Session 2 · Planning — secure config and progressive delivery
Planning: secure configuration and progressive delivery
What is it about? Before MVP 2 we must ship safely: stop saying “let’s be careful”
and have a concrete plan with owners, switches and an emergency exit.
Like a building’s keys: you know who has which,
where it is kept and when it gets changed.
Owner — who is accountable for it
Store — where it lives (never in git)
Like a light switch: turn a feature on or off
without touching or redeploying the code.
Clear name — you can tell what it does
A flag is a temporary switch, not architecture
Like tasting the soup with a spoonful before
No redeploy · every risky change has an exit
If something is missing, fail fast
Injected from the store; scanner in CI
New feature behind a flag, off
Ships with a defined canary plan
Flip the flag off in under 1 minute
Each story with testable acceptance criteria
Straight to 100%, no flag, no rollback
If it fails: flip the flag off in seconds
No owner, rotation or least privilege
Only thought of during the incident
Plan the rollback before the release, not during the outage
